description: This file sets up an Express.js server that provides a web interface and API endpoints for visualizing and interacting with multiple types of databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It includes environment variable loading, database connection testing, and data retrieval functions with specific classes and methods for handling different database systems.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, providing common interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and retrieving data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class extending DatabaseAdapter for SQL-based databases, implementing execution of queries and common table/data retrieval logic.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for PostgreSQL, implementing specific database queries and execution logic.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for MySQL databases, including specific execution and query methods.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for SQLite databases, handling local file-based database connection, testing, and querying.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for MongoDB, implementing connection, collection listing, and data fetching functionalities.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from environment-specific .env files for various database types.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and logs the results.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Handles API routes, executing database-specific operations and returning results or errors.
